clue.text: Quiet girl upset one married traveller

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for playing quietly

indicators.note: upset means the letters of girl are knocked over into a new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A quiet girl gets upset with a married man she meets on her journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilgrim is someone who makes a journey to a holy place, so a kind of traveller.

clue.text: Dad's keeping half of ugly growths

indicators.note: keeping means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: pop is a name for dad, so dad's gives pop's

indicators.note: half of takes the back two of the four letters of ugly

explanation.surface: Father has some ugly lumps.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyps are small abnormal growths of tissue, for example in the nose or bowel.

clue.text: Place requiring no bill to return cream

indicators.note: requiring no means these letters are taken out of the place word

parts.note: a location is a place

indicators.note: to return means the abbreviation for bill is read backwards before it is removed

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A spot where there's no bill to pay for putting the cream back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To return' turns AC into CA, which comes out of LOCATION.
explanation.definitionFit: A lotion is a smooth liquid cream applied to the skin.

clue.text: Censures proper answer in tears

indicators.note: in means these pieces are placed inside the word for tears

parts.note: rends means tears, as a verb
prim means prim and proper, prudishly correct

explanation.surface: Someone tells a decent answer off and ends up in tears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tears' is the verb (rips), not crying: RENDS.
explanation.definitionFit: Reprimands as a verb means rebukes formally, the same as censures.

clue.text: Ties up, as engines losing temperature

indicators.note: losing means a letter drops out of the word for engines

parts.note: motors are engines

explanation.surface: Engines that lose heat get tied up.
explanation.definitionFit: To moor a boat is to tie it up at a quay or buoy.

clue.text: Annoying people and soldiers when protecting church

parts.note: soldiers are men, as in officers and men

indicators.note: protecting means one piece wraps around another to guard it, so as goes round church

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Pests and soldiers turn up while a church is being guarded.
explanation.definitionFit: Menaces are nuisances or pests, people who annoy and bother others.

clue.text: Pal may keep Turkish spirit mostly for such a journalist

indicators.note: may keep means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: mucker is British slang for a friend or pal

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the spirit is dropped

parts.note: raki is an aniseed spirit from Turkey

explanation.surface: A friend might keep most of a bottle of Turkish liquor for a reporter.
explanation.walkthrough: MUCKER is informal British for a mate.
explanation.definitionFit: A muckraker is a journalist who digs up scandal about public figures.

clue.text: Time of celebration may be held up by little ones

indicators.note: held up says the hidden letters are read backwards
by means the letters are found beside and within the words little ones, spanning their join

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Christmas may be delayed by the children.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft definition included 'may be', but that is a link: NOEL cannot stand in for 'time of celebration may be'. In a down clue 'held up' reads the hidden letters upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Noel is another word for Christmas, the festive season.

clue.text: Broadminded member of church

definitions.meaning: ... with a small c means wide-ranging or liberal in tastes
a ... belongs to the Roman ... Church

explanation.definitionFit: Catholic means universal or all-embracing in outlook, and also an adherent of the Roman Catholic Church.

clue.text: Technologically advanced green must accept progress

indicators.note: must accept means one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: sage is a grey-green colour
pace is the rate of progress

explanation.surface: An environmental campaigner must accept technological progress.
explanation.definitionFit: Space-age describes something very modern or futuristic, so technologically advanced.

clue.text: Relief obtained from backing dispute likely?

indicators.note: backing says the hidden letters are read backwards
obtained from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A question of whether some relief can be got from an argument that looks likely to back down.
explanation.definitionFit: A let-up is a pause or easing, a relief from pressure or effort.

clue.text: Where some members may be on the fiddle?

definitions.text: Where some members may be on the fiddle?

parts.words: Where some members may be on the fiddle?
parts.note: on the fiddle suggests cheating, but here it means playing the violin, as players in a large band of musicians do

explanation.surface: A hint at a club or organisation where some members are running a scam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the fiddle' is British slang for cheating or fraud; the second reading is literal: some members of this ensemble play violins.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra's string section includes violinists, members who literally play the fiddle.

clue.text: This may be given by Sioux after losing protection

definitions.text: This may be given by Sioux after losing protection

parts.words: This may be given by Sioux after losing protection
parts.note: Sioux losing its outer letters leaves a familiar three-letter written pledge to pay, which is an example of this answer

explanation.surface: A tribe of Native Americans giving something up once their defences are gone.
explanation.walkthrough: Strip the outside letters (its 'protection') from SIOUX and you get IOU, the 'I owe you' note: an IOU is a promissory note, so the clue describes the answer by an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A promissory note is a written promise to pay a sum, of which an IOU is the informal kind.

clue.text: See 11
What cleaner needs to baffle the clergy?

parts.note: to floor someone is to baffle or confound them
the cloth is a collective term for the clergy

explanation.surface: A puzzle about what a cleaner needs in order to bewilder the priests.
explanation.definitionFit: A floorcloth is the rag used for wiping floors, a basic piece of cleaning kit.

clue.text: What the overcharging assassin might do?

definitions.text: What the overcharging assassin might do?

parts.words: What the overcharging assassin might do?
parts.note: an idiom for earning a fortune, read literally for a killer who charges a lot

explanation.surface: Wondering what a hitman who charges too much would get up to.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase means to profit hugely; an assassin who overcharges does that while also literally killing someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a killing is an idiom for earning a great deal of money quickly.

clue.text: Raising last couple of children without jewellery?

indicators.note: last couple of takes the final two letters of children

parts.note: no can mean without, as in no money
bling is slang for showy jewellery

explanation.surface: Bringing up the last two children without any jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raising' looks like child-rearing, but it means elevating to the peerage.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennobling means raising someone to the nobility, or elevating in dignity.

clue.text: Respected, as some guide meets everybody on the way up

indicators.note: on the way up means the letters are read upwards in this down entry, so backwards
some means only part of the following words is used, a run of letters within them

explanation.surface: A guide who meets everybody along an uphill path is respected.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteemed means highly regarded or admired, that is respected.

clue.text: Put it on and stay to support mother

indicators.note: to support means in this down entry the second piece sits under the first

parts.note: ma is mother
to linger is to stay on

explanation.surface: Pretend, and stay behind to look after your mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put it on' means feign illness, not dress.
explanation.definitionFit: To malinger is to fake illness to avoid work, that is to put it on.

clue.text: Temporary stablehand should get limited accommodation

parts.note: a stand-in is a temporary substitute
a groom looks after horses in a stable

explanation.surface: A temporary stable worker ought to be given only cramped lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing room is space where people can only stand, such as at a full venue, so very limited accommodation.

clue.text: Stress line of descent

explanation.definitionFit: A strain is both pressure or tension and a particular breed or ancestry.

clue.text: Stick had broken before

indicators.note: broken means the letters of had are smashed and rearranged

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: A stick had been broken earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: To adhere is to stick fast, as glue does.

clue.text: Wrong, as it happens going west

indicators.note: going west means reading from right to left, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: a live broadcast is one shown as it happens

explanation.surface: Something goes wrong, just as it happens, heading westward.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil as a noun is wickedness or wrongdoing, so a wrong.

clue.text: Face doubts, upset and confused

indicators.note: upset means the letters of face doubts are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone confronted with doubts becomes upset and muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: Obfuscated means made obscure or unclear, so confused in the sense of muddled.

clue.text: Bones from land oddly captured by Emirates

indicators.note: captured by means these letters are held inside the abbreviation for the Emirates

parts.note: UAE is the United Arab Emirates

indicators.note: oddly takes the first and third letters of land

explanation.surface: Bones from some land have been seized by the Emirates.
explanation.definitionFit: The ulnae are the inner forearm bones, plural of ulna.

clue.text: Geographical feature of a day in the West End?

indicators.note: in means these pieces go inside the postcode

parts.note: W1 is the postcode district for London's West End, written WI

explanation.surface: A landform you might spot on a day out in London's West End.
explanation.walkthrough: London's West End, its theatre and shopping district, has the postcode W1, read as WI.
explanation.definitionFit: A wadi is a dry river valley in desert regions, a feature of the landscape.

clue.text: Motorway beginning to generally limit movement

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's first motorway, written MI in crosswords

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the opening letter of the next word, generally

parts.note: to ration is to limit supplies

explanation.surface: A motorway that starts to restrict traffic in general.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the main motorway running north from London.
explanation.definitionFit: Migration is the movement of people or animals from one region to another.

clue.text: Speak of charge applied to oxygen

indicators.note: applied to means one piece is put after the other, so charge follows oxygen

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
a rate is a charge, as in an hourly rate

explanation.surface: Talking about what is charged for supplying oxygen.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to speak formally or pompously, as in a speech.

clue.text: Brave, crossing line for sweetheart

indicators.note: crossing means one piece goes across and around another, so brave wraps line

parts.note: daring means bold or brave

explanation.surface: A brave person crosses a line for the one they love.
explanation.definitionFit: Darling is a term of endearment for a loved one, the same as sweetheart.

clue.text: Improve contents of menu and fortune with leader gone

indicators.note: contents of means the inside letters of menu, leaving out its ends
with leader gone means the first letter of the word for fortune is dropped

parts.note: chance is luck or fortune

explanation.surface: Making a restaurant's menu better and earning a fortune once the boss has left.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance something is to raise its quality, that is to improve it.
